violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: observed there was visible food debris on the two slicers which the person in charge said were clean.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The person in charge said she would clean and sanitize the two slicers the next day.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. The small aerosol can of Pro Master lubricant was stored with food on a shelf over the slicer and with food on the same shelf.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The person in charge moved the lubricant during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Incidental Food Contact, Criteria
violations.observation: Lubricants with incidental food contact do not meet the requirements in 21 CFR 178.3570. A small aerosol can of Pro Master lubricant was being used to lubricate the underside of the slicers. Any lubricant used on food contact equipment in a food establishment must be labeled “food grade” or GRAS (generally recognized as safe), which this product was not.
violations.corrective_action: Lubricants used on food equipment may directly or indirectly come into contact with food and therefore must be approved as a food additive. The person in charge removed the product during the inspection.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed a clean knife was stored in a manner that exposed the item to contamination. It was stored in the gap between the knee wall and the outside of the prep refrigerator on the prep line behind the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. The person in charge moved the knife during the inspection to correct. JAVA WORKS FAIRVIEW PARK DELI (Inspection Date: 09/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the grease trap lid was removed from the grease trap. The lid was removed so that a new one could be ordered. The grease trap was temporarily covered with a cardboard box. There was also a significant foul odor in this area due to the lid being missing.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Repair or replace the grease trap lid as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The 2025 health permit was posted, but the 2026 permit was not.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Locate and post the 2026 health permit as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) in the Norlake 2-door upright refrigerator were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Gyro meat was 48º, hummus was 48º, and 50º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The hummus and gyro meat were discarded. CDI. Other foods were moved to another refrigerator which was working properly.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: several packages of sliced cheeses which are sliced on site were not date-marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. The PIC corrected this by date-marking the cheeses. CDI.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the ambient temperature of the Norlake 2-door upright refrigerator was 48º and foods inside were above 41º. There was also a puddle of water on the bottom shelf of the unit, indicating it is leaking.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Have the unit serviced as soon as possible. Move all TCS foods to the next refrigerator. Contact the EHS when the unit is serviced and working properly.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed a foul odor coming from the grease trap.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC stated the grease trap is schedule to be cleaned tomorrow. Please clean the grease trap as soon as possible. It might help to replace the grease trap lid. The lid is rusted and deteriorated. JAVA WORKS FAIRVIEW PARK DELI (Inspection Date: 04/02/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The person in charge corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Correct prior to the next routine inspection.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: the main prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. The person in charge corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: two knives were stored between the side of the prep refrigerator and the wall next to it.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The person in charge corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: the can opener blade was visibly soiled with food debris.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The person in charge washed rinsed and sanitized the can opener blade during the inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVATIOn: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Almond milk in carton at 50 F in Norlake-2 DR under-counter refrigerator. Unit at 50 F
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Item discarded, unit will not be use till repaired. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Enclosed components of ice bin are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.
